name: Tool Error Latch
description: Tracks tool failures per session and logs failure and recovery transitions without modifying prompts or messages.

enabled.description: Master toggle for tool error latching behavior.

ttlMs.description: How long an unresolved latch stays active for a session before expiring.

maxSessions.description: Maximum number of sessions kept in latch memory.

messageTemplate.description: Deprecated compatibility option. It is ignored because this plugin no longer modifies messages.
